english_verification.review_scope: Representative names, opening identity, source prose and actual fixed-revision Wiki passages, plus native national-idea text compared by localisation key. Large mission/idea ranges are locator envelopes, not exhaustive checks of every intervening line or runtime reachability.

rationale.campaign_length: 41 direct missions and a possible continuation through Z34.
rationale.colonization: Northern colonisation is a secondary branch.
rationale.complexity: Border defence, naval power, industry, and formation requirements interlock.
rationale.dark_story: The tone is a hard monarchy shaped by revenge; ordinary war is not treated as atrocity.
rationale.difficulty: You must survive strong neighbours and meet restoration requirements; not playtested.
rationale.diplomacy: Truces and allies matter, but are not the central loop.
rationale.early_pressure: Several strong neighbours and Orcish pressure create the opening crisis.
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: Ebonsteel craft is distinctive, but it is not a magic–artifice mainline.
rationale.narrative_density: The Ebonfrost dynasty, Greytide, and restoration form one narrative arc.
rationale.tall_play: Industry matters, but the mission end state depends on territory.
rationale.trade_economy: Black Pine shipping and Ebonsteel investment require sustained finances.
rationale.warfare: Northern wars and restoration are the central military arc.

identity.appearance: A northern 1444 remnant of the Ebonfrost dynasty.
identity.formation_scope: After meeting the Gerudian formation decision, Z15 can become Z34 Black Castanor; the original Z15 can continue its missions.

national_ideas.scope_note: National traditions, seven ideas, and ambition only; no optional idea groups or racial/government bonuses. Multiple sets and conditions are listed separately and are not simultaneous; formation acceptance depends on the actual decision and player choice.

description.text: Past the mountains and vales of Urviksten lies an expansive, forbidding mireland known as the Giants Tears. These lands are harsh and unforgiving, long being a land unpopulated except for the hardiest of individuals. But now the Giant's Tears are inhabited by orcs, vile creatures. Urviksten must secure this frontier against them.

description.text: Castan Ebonfrost, legendary conqueror of Escann, conquerer of Castanor, was born and raised in Urviksten. While he left this land with his followers and the famous black dragon, his dynasty lives on in Urviksten. After his demise, one of Castanor's sons, Urvik, returned to Urviksten with an army of his own to retake the homeland. Since then Urviksten has retained the strict and disciplined army tactics of Castan Ebonfrost's army.

description.text: While the fjords of Urviksten are cold, unforgiving and bleak, they are full of natural resources, especially prime timber. Unique with their black trunks, the Black Pines of the Black Frost Mountains are hard as iron, although with the right technique can easily be felled. Not only useful for ships, they are also excellent for improving production due to their increased toughness.

description.text: To the south, in the Giants Tears and in Castanor, vast hordes of orcish scum rampage across the lands. While they may have destroyed the ancient and powerful lands to the south, the descendants of Castan Ebonfrost are more than powerful enough to remove these filth. You need only apply force where needed, and shove elsewhere.

description.text: Banners waving in the wind, as pale as fresh snow, emblazoned with the black dragon of Castan Ebonfrost, wave above the armies of Urviksten. Possessing a vast military, Urviksten is more of a military with a state attached than a state with an army. The economy and politics of Urviksten are all focused to make the army as efficient, and numerous, as possible.

description.text: The prize of Urviksten, and of Castanor in the past, the Ebonsteel Armory is a vast foundry, blacksmith and armory supplying high quality weapons and armor made of Ebonsteel, a dark naturally alloyed metal found throughout Urviksten.

description.text: Castan Ebonfrost conquered Escann, Castanor and even Vertesk. All these lands rightfully belong to Urviksten, heirs to Castanor. The Black Dragon Banner will wave from the Silvermere to the Dameshead Sea once more!

description.text:
Castan Ebonfrost was the legendary conqueror of Castanor, hailing from the cold lands of Urviksten. In his youth he was a lowborn Reaver who rose the ranks after many years of raiding. Word of his exploits spread across the lands, and in 865 he was awarded the dominion of Vrorenmarch as a ploy by Castanor.

A year later he smashed through Castanor with his armies and killed Castan XLVIII, and crowned himself as the new Castan of Castanor. He did so by sacking the temple of Castellos on the Trialmount, which guards and administers the trials which decide the leader of Castanor, known as Castan. Afterwards, the only individuals allowed to take the trials were descendents of the Ebonfrost dynasty, maintained by the Ebon Guard.

description.text: The Ebon Guard were the elite military force of Black Castanor, answering only to Castan Ebonfrost and his successors. Outfitted with Ebonsteel armor and weaponry, they were feared throughout the world. The Ebon Guard was primarily made up of strong Gerudians of Ebonmarck, although some of the native Escanni that proved worthy were given the privilege of joining the Guard. Most famous for guarding the Trialmount, the Ebon Guard also served in military maneuvers that required only the best of the best.

description.text: A legendary artifact, Ebonfrost's Fist was a magical gauntlet infused with the strength of golems. Famous for his explosive anger, Castan Ebonfrost wore this gauntlet to smash tables to make his point clear, or to make his point even more clear by beating his opposition into submission.

description.text: Black Castanor conquered far and wide, from the Serpentspine Mountains to Vertesk on the Dameshead Sea. No empire had boasted such a claim since the glory days of old Castanor. Although these lands have gone astray after the disintegration of Black Castanor following the War of the Sorcerer-King, none can deny the ancient bounds of our empire. With Black Castanor restored, we should utilize these extensive claims to restore our realm beyond Escann!

description.text: One of the most important innovations of Black Castanor, Ebonsteel paved the way for the extensive conquest and pacification of lands by Black Castanor. A special steel-like black alloy, lighter and stronger than already-rare steel, can be found in the Black Frost mountains of Urviksten, but can also be created with a special combination of metals and minerals. With this art reborn, the armies of Black Castanor will once more conquer the lands bearing this superior steel.

description.text: Black Castanor was founded by Reavers, both in the past and in the new restoration of the realm. These legendary warriors formed the first generation of soldiers that conquered the land, and in order to preserve this advantage Castan Ebonfrost established the Black Reaver Academy. This Academy trained the officers of the realm in the art of war, in the Gerudian way that is unique and strange to the Escanni. Although it was ransacked and razed by the League of so-called Free Realms at the end of the War of the Sorcerer-King, we have rebuilt this magnificent institution to ensure that our martial heritage may never be lost!

description.text: One of the staples of warfare is a constant supply of manpower. Castanor in the days of the Ebonfrost were plagued by treasonous lords who thwarted our rightful rule both openly and behind closed doors. Even centuries later, even after the destruction of the Escanni by the Greentide, the land still harbors traitors. In order to subdue the pretenders and retake our rightful lands, an act must be passed to make sure that our reserves are always full by enforcing conscription. The lords and nobility will no longer be able to hamper our efforts any more.

player_overview.avoid_if: Players who want relaxed development or do not want to handle strong neighbours and strict formation requirements.
player_overview.how_it_plays: Hold the border and find a breakthrough first, then develop ports, industry, and the army, and finally pursue the old imperial inheritance.
player_overview.overview: Urviksten is the Ebonfrost dynasty's northern remnant still holding on in 1444. You face Orcish border pressure, northern neighbours, and naval competition while developing the Black Pine fleet and conditional Ebonsteel industry, gradually securing the territory and qualifications needed to restore Black Castanor. This is a difficult dynastic restoration campaign, not a strong opening country.
player_overview.recommended_for: Players who enjoy hard northern wars, dynastic restoration, and simultaneous land and naval play.
signature_features: The revival story of Karl II and the Ebonfrost dynasty.
Black Pine sea power and Ebonsteel industry form the armaments arc.
After strict requirements are met, Z34 Black Castanor can be formed and the missions can continue.
player_overview.tagline: Revive the Ebonfrost dynasty from a northern remnant and ultimately claim the name Black Castanor.

reasons: The Ebonfrost restoration route is clear.
The Black Pine fleet and Ebonsteel industry are distinctive.
Forming Z34 provides a long-term objective.
warnings: Several strong enemies create a multi-front opening.
Some Ebonsteel content is limited by DLC and conditions.

positive_indicators: Developing a fleet and armaments to protect the frontier.
values.rationale: Resisting raids and protecting the country are concrete public aims; Karl's cruel personality, hard monarchy, and revenge setting limit a high score. War and monarchy are not deductions by themselves, and later occupation policy was not fully checked.
red_flags: Karl II has the cruel personality trait.
Revenge and concentrated royal power may override residents' interests.
